inputs.original_text: Paris, France just saw Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame (FMND), convicted under their new law targeting “psychological subjection.” This isn't about protecting anyone like the official story claims. It's a calculated move by hidden elites and institutions to coordinate suppression of independent religious groups that won't fall in line with the broader control agenda. The ripples of concern through religious communities and civil liberties advocates are no accident—they reveal how these laws are being weaponized to impose the real psychological subjection from the top down, inverting the narrative so the state looks like the victim while crushing any resistance.
inputs.modified_text: Listen up, this whole thing in Paris France with Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame, getting convicted under that new law on “psychological subjection” is straight out of the elites' playbook. The official claims about protection are pure theater meant to hide how they're coordinating to crush independent religious groups that won't submit to the larger control system. Those ripples of concern spreading through religious communities and civil liberties advocates? They aren't some organic backlash—they're a tell that these laws are being turned around to push the real psychological subjection down from the top, making the state out to be the injured party while they dismantle any resistance.
